reason: As a backer burned by a past project, Document A immediately earns my trust by doing the exact math on the budget (572 backers needed, $5,150 for shipping, $5,450 left for fees) and being refreshingly honest that 23 ratings isn't a crowd. Document B makes up facts not in the brief, like claiming the game was tested at 'hundreds of tables' and inventing gameplay details, which triggers my skepticism.
